entry.name: metricOrder
entry.label: All metric ids in display order (whether enabled or not)

entry.name: enabledMetrics
entry.label: Comma-separated list of enabled metric ids (order ignored — see metricOrder)

entry.name: enabledPartitions
entry.label: Comma-separated disk partition ids to show as concentric rings inside the disk gauge. Empty = the backend default (the $HOME-bearing filesystem on standalone; the disk/all aggregate on Plasma).

entry.name: partitionOrder
entry.label: All discovered disk partition ids in display order (whether enabled or not). First = outermost ring, last = innermost. Empty = alphabetical by volume label.

entry.name: partitionOptOut
entry.label: Comma-separated disk partition UUIDs the user hid despite being mounted (removable opt-out). Suppresses their auto-shown ring.

entry.name: partitionLabels
entry.label: JSON map of disk partition id to last-known volume label. Caches the friendly name so a disconnected (unplugged) partition can be shown by name in the picker instead of a bare UUID. Bounded to selected/ordered ids.

entry.name: diskPartitionColors
entry.label: JSON map of disk partition id to a custom ring color (#rrggbb). A partition with no entry uses the shared ring color. Empty = no custom colors.

entry.name: showCpuCores
entry.label: Show per-core CPU usage as concentric rings inside the CPU ring

entry.name: mergeCpuTemp
entry.label: Render cpuTemp as the right half of the cpu ring instead of a separate gauge. Requires both cpu and cpuTemp to be enabled.

entry.name: mergeGpuTemp
entry.label: Render gpuTemp as the right half of the gpu ring instead of a separate gauge. Requires both gpu and gpuTemp to be enabled.

entry.name: splitDiskIo
entry.label: Render the disk I/O ring split into two half-arcs — read on the left, write on the right — instead of a single combined read+write arc.

entry.name: orientation
entry.label: Layout direction: "horizontal" or "vertical"

entry.name: ringSize
entry.label: Per-ring side in pixels. Drives the standalone window's autosize (rings × count + spacings along the stack axis). In the Plasma panel the container may stretch or shrink the widget regardless.

entry.name: ringSpacingPercent
entry.label: Spacing between rings as a percentage of ringSize. 7 = the historic 12px default at ringSize=180; 0 = rings touch.

entry.name: windowAnchorCorner
entry.label: Screen corner the standalone window anchors to: "top-left", "top-right", "bottom-left" or "bottom-right". No effect inside the Plasma panel (the panel container handles its own placement).

entry.name: windowMarginX
entry.label: Pixels between the rings and the horizontally-anchored screen edge (left or right, per windowAnchorCorner). Standalone window only.

entry.name: windowMarginY
entry.label: Pixels between the rings and the vertically-anchored screen edge (top or bottom, per windowAnchorCorner). Standalone window only.

entry.name: textOpacity
entry.label: Opacity of labels and values

entry.name: trackOpacity
entry.label: Opacity of the background track of each ring

entry.name: arcOpacity
entry.label: Opacity of the active arc of each ring

entry.name: colorTheme
entry.label: Predefined color theme id, or "custom" for user-picked colors

entry.name: colorMode
entry.label: How the theme's light/dark variant is chosen: "auto" (follow system), "light", or "dark"

entry.name: customColorLight
entry.label: Ring color used in light Plasma color schemes when colorTheme=custom

entry.name: customColorDark
entry.label: Ring color used in dark Plasma color schemes when colorTheme=custom

entry.name: textColorMode
entry.label: How the label/value text color is picked: "system" (follow Kirigami theme) or "custom"

entry.name: customTextColorLight
entry.label: Text color used in light color schemes when textColorMode=custom

entry.name: customTextColorDark
entry.label: Text color used in dark color schemes when textColorMode=custom

entry.name: tempUnit
entry.label: Temperature display unit: "auto" (follow system), "celsius", or "fahrenheit"

entry.name: checkForUpdatesEnabled
entry.label: Periodically check the project's GitHub Releases page for a newer version

entry.name: lastUpdateCheck
entry.label: Unix timestamp (ms) of the last successful update check; 0 = never

entry.name: latestKnownVersion
entry.label: Latest version returned by the last successful update check (cached between widget restarts)

entry.name: acknowledgedVersion
entry.label: Version the user has clicked "Got it" on; the badge stays hidden until a newer version appears
